messages:
Aisha (CS): Quick heads-up — Merchantly renewal is on a 14-day runway. They want to move to a 9mo term, add seats, and enable SSO. Procurement says they need a PO and a delegated signatory. Can we triage pricing + signature path?
Evan AE: Do we have flexibility on the 9mo pricing? Customer asked for 12% off ARR. I can approve up to 8% if CS/legal confirm signatory evidence.
Ben Ops: PO workflow is ok. If they need a vendor code, I can spin one up (net30). Also confirm billing entity (US vs EU) for tax.
Sara Legal: We need verification of the delegated signer — email from CFO or org chart screenshot will work. Also flag me if they request T&C edits.
Aisha (CS): Customer wants standard T&Cs but asked for an explicit EU data residency clause. I asked procurement to confirm signer and PO.
Evan AE: Fine on T&Cs + residency clause. I'll offer 8% for a same-day commit; otherwise fallback to 5%.
Ben Ops: Draft invoice for ops to validate. Can someone confirm final seat count?
```
Invoice draft:
Customer: Merchantly Inc.
Term: 9 months
Seats: 25
List price (prorated): $67,500
Discount: 8% -> $62,100
Invoice net30 to billing@merchantly.com
PO: <pending>
Line items: seats, SSO, onboarding
```
Aisha (CS): Confirmed 25 seats with the customer. Procurement asked for a PO template showing separate line items — uploaded to thread.
Sara Legal: For the delegated signatory we should capture: 1) an email from CFO authorizing the signer; 2) a screenshot of the signer in their corporate directory. Save both to contract folder.
Aisha (CS): Looping back to procurement for the CFO email and signer corporate address.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created (env_0X9a7). Recipient: merchantly.signer@merchantly.com. Status: sent.
Evan AE: Sending with the 8% concession language and residency clause. Aisha — confirm clause included?
Aisha (CS): Confirmed. Clause pasted under Section 7: "Customer data at rest for EU accounts will reside in EU region unless otherwise agreed."
Ben Ops: Vendor code requested: VND-9312. Marking billing note to accept PO when uploaded.
Aisha (CS): Procurement replied: "Signer is Jane K. (Legal Ops). CFO will email approval after sign." They uploaded PO template and want 3 line items.
Evan AE: If Jane signs today I'll mark closed in CRM and approve the 8% concession.
Sara Legal: When CFO email arrives, save to contract artifacts and add a clause in the agreement noting delegated signer evidence.
Aisha (CS): Signed via DocuSign at 2024-06-10T15:27Z (env_0X9a7). CFO confirmation forwarded to legal.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env_0X9a7 status: completed. Signed at 2024-06-10T15:27Z by merchantly.signer@merchantly.com.
Ben Ops: PO uploaded to billing as PO-548321 referencing vendor VND-9312. Invoice issued for $62,100 net30.
Evan AE: Marking renewal closed in CRM: 9mo term, 25 seats, 8% discount. Nice execution.
Aisha (CS): Closing loop — invoice sent, legal artifacts saved, vendor code created. Action for onboarding: schedule kickoff Tue 10am PT.
Sara Legal: All contract artifacts saved. No further legal blockers.
Aisha (CS): Thanks all! :tada:
